title: CLCON/110/2005 of AJIT KUMAR Vs V.K. SHARMA, PRINCIPAL SEC. FOREST, GOVT. OF U.P.

paras.text:
Contempt Petition No.110/2005
Hon'ble J.C.S. Rawat, J.
 It was pointed out by the
learned counsels that the petitioner has
been promoted in pursuance of the
order passed by the court. As such,
the petition rendered infructuous.
 In view of the above
submission advanced by the learned
counsel for the petitioner, the
contempt petition is dismissed as
infructuous.
 The notices issued to the
contemnors are hereby discharged.
